messages:
Maya (Support): Halo Health reached out — they say a promotional onboarding credit (ONBOARD1000) didn't fully apply. They attached invoice and chat screenshots: https://console.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-0210

Maya (Support): Customer expects $1,500 onboarding credit; invoice shows only $350 applied. Asking for correction and brief explanation.

Rina (Customer Success): Halo Health is strategic (pilot). Promo was granted during onboarding by CS. They were promised $1,500 credit to offset first-month spikes.

BillingBot (system): Invoice snapshot for INV-2026-0210:
- Total before credits: $5,720
- Credits applied: $350
- Expected credits per CS note: $1,500
- Discrepancy: $1,150
(Report ID: RPT-2026-0623-11)

OpsBot (system): Flag: promo tag ONBOARD1000 present on account metadata but credit_job CJ-7789 failed on 2026-06-23 02:17 UTC due to timeout. Retry attempts recorded: 3.

Diego (Finance): Thanks. For cases like this we typically post a manual adjustment equal to the missing $1,150, tag GL-4120 (Customer discounts) and create ACCT ticket for reconciliation. Approve to proceed?

Rina (Customer Success): Recommend full correction ASAP. Customer is sensitive to billing surprises during pilot. We'll take internal follow-up with CS ops.

Diego (Finance): Approved. Please include a short accounting note referencing CS ticket CS-4418. Also add reason: "Manual promo fulfillment".

BillingBot (system): Suggested ledger command (ops only):

redwood-bill adjust --cust HA-112 --invoice INV-2026-0210 --amount -1150 --type credit --gl GL-4120 --note "Manual promo fulfillment ONBOARD1000; CS:CS-4418; CJ-7789 timeout"

Maya (Support): Will run after getting final thumbs. Also will draft customer message: "We're applying a $1,150 credit to complete your onboarding promo; updated invoice will be posted shortly."

Diego (Finance): Execute and attach adjustment ID and updated PDF to CS-4418. Open accounting ticket ACCT-7955 for month-end.

BillingBot (system): Simulation before execution: Applying -$1,150 will set new invoice total to $4,220. No downstream subscription proration effects detected.

Maya (Support): Executing now (ops user) at 1775131200.

BillingBot (system): Adjustment executed. Adjustment ID ADJ-35007. Updated invoice PDF: https://console.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-0210/adjusted/ADJ-35007.pdf. Journal entry queued under GL-4120.

Diego (Finance): Confirmed ADJ-35007 and ACCT-7955 created. Accounting note: "Manual promo fulfillment ONBOARD1000 for HA-112; CS:CS-4418; CJ-7789"

Rina (Customer Success): Customer notified and appreciative. Also filed internal CS ops ticket to re-run failed credit job for logging.

OpsBot (system): Recommend adding a retry backoff and alert on CJ job failures to avoid manual steps. Create task PROD-8822.

Diego (Finance): Closing from finance side after ACCT-7955 posts. Thanks team.

Maya (Support): Closing thread — customer confirmed invoice looks correct. :white_check_mark:
